mechanism_narrative: If WORKPLACES stays near its current depressed level while TRANSIT remains weak, weekday trips for discretionary shopping stay suppressed and RETAIL_REC will be lower over the next four weeks than over the last four weeks.
failure_condition: RETAIL_REC rises over the next 28 days despite WORKPLACES and TRANSIT remaining at or below their current four-week means.

mechanism_narrative: A further drop in RESIDENTIAL relative to its current elevated level implies more time spent away from home, which shifts spending toward retail and recreation within one to two weeks and lifts RETAIL_REC.
candidate_trigger: RESIDENTIAL falls at least 1 point week-on-week from its current level
failure_condition: RETAIL_REC does not increase within 14 days after a week-on-week decline in RESIDENTIAL.

mechanism_narrative: When GROCERY_PHARM and WORKPLACES both weaken together, it signals broader containment of out-of-home activity that spills into discretionary shopping and pushes RETAIL_REC down over the next month.
failure_condition: RETAIL_REC is flat or higher over the next 28 days even though both GROCERY_PHARM and WORKPLACES remain below their current levels.

mechanism_narrative: A continued decline in PARKS after an already weak month indicates unfavorable outdoor demand conditions, which also dampen nearby leisure and shopping trips and reduce RETAIL_REC within two weeks.
candidate_trigger: PARKS falls below -30 and stays there for two consecutive weeks
failure_condition: RETAIL_REC rises within 14 days after PARKS crosses below -30 and remains depressed.

mechanism_narrative: If TRANSIT stabilizes while WORKPLACES stops declining, commuting-linked retail trips recover first in the following month, making RETAIL_REC higher than its recent four-week average.
failure_condition: RETAIL_REC remains below its prior four-week mean even after TRANSIT and WORKPLACES both stop falling.

mechanism_narrative: A short-run rise in GROCERY_PHARM reflects more frequent errand activity and neighborhood circulation, which spills over into other shopping and entertainment visits and lifts RETAIL_REC within one week.
candidate_trigger: GROCERY_PHARM rises for two consecutive weeks
failure_condition: RETAIL_REC does not increase in the week after GROCERY_PHARM posts two consecutive weekly gains.

mechanism_narrative: If TRANSIT remains deeply suppressed while RESIDENTIAL stays elevated, then substitution toward at-home activity dominates and retail visitation falls over the next four weeks.
candidate_trigger: TRANSIT stays below -50 while RESIDENTIAL stays above 13
failure_condition: RETAIL_REC improves over the next 28 days even though TRANSIT remains below -50 and RESIDENTIAL remains above 13.

mechanism_narrative: In a low-mobility regime, a rebound in PARKS together with a smaller drag from TRANSIT indicates broader outdoor circulation and should lift discretionary retail visits over the next two weeks.
candidate_trigger: PARKS rises at least 3 points from the current week while TRANSIT does not fall further
failure_condition: RETAIL_REC fails to rise within 14 days after PARKS rebounds and TRANSIT stops declining.
